measurement.rtp: sum of actual payouts divided by sum of actual BET; replay makes next BET free
measurement.complete: first net +10000pt or 30000G; full trajectories retain the stopped prefix
measurement.reset: special mode and setting-dependent reset impurity at the start of every trial
measurement.operation: model play, correct instructed stop order
measurement.seeds: same seed for each paired v116/v117 trial; disjoint from candidate-selection pilot
measurement.selection: fixed candidate before verification; all 1000 prespecified pairs per setting
